import numpy as np
print("COMPONENTS", COMPONENTS)
print("VOCAB", VOCAB)
for k, v in W.items():
    print(k, v.shape)

np.set_printoptions(precision=3, suppress=True, linewidth=180)
E = W["embed.W_E"]
P = W["pos_embed.W_pos"]
U = W["unembed.W_U"]
print("Embedding norms", np.linalg.norm(E,axis=1))
print("Position norms", np.linalg.norm(P,axis=1))
print("Embedding Gram\n", E @ E.T)
for l in range(2):
    for h in range(4):
        pref = f"blocks.{l}.attn."
        Q,K,V,O = [W[pref+n][h] for n in ("W_Q","W_K","W_V","W_O")]
        print(l,h,"norms Q K V O",*[round(float(np.linalg.norm(a)),3) for a in (Q,K,V,O)])
        print("token Q/K/V variation", *[round(float(np.linalg.norm((E@a) - (E@a).mean(0))),3) for a in (Q,K,V)])
        print("pos Q/K/V variation", *[round(float(np.linalg.norm((P@a) - (P@a).mean(0))),3) for a in (Q,K,V)])
        if l==0 and h==0:
            tq=E@Q+W[pref+"b_Q"][h]
            tk=E@K+W[pref+"b_K"][h]
            print("token QK scores",tq@tk.T/np.sqrt(6))
            print("pos QK scores",(P@Q)@(P@K).T/np.sqrt(6))
            print("E OV",E@V@O)
for l in range(2):
    A = W[f"blocks.{l}.mlp.W_in"]
    B = W[f"blocks.{l}.mlp.W_out"]
    print("MLP",l,"norms",np.linalg.norm(A), np.linalg.norm(B))
    print("token->MLP norm",np.linalg.norm(E@A),"pos->MLP norm",np.linalg.norm(P@A))
    print("W_in singular values",np.linalg.svd(A,compute_uv=False))
    print("W_out singular values",np.linalg.svd(B,compute_uv=False))

pref="blocks.0.attn."
for h in range(4):
    Q,K,V,O=[W[pref+n][h] for n in ("W_Q","W_K","W_V","W_O")]
    q=(E[:11]+P[1])@Q+W[pref+"b_Q"][h]
    kn=(E[:11]+P[2])@K+W[pref+"b_K"][h]
    kb=(E[11]+P[0])@K+W[pref+"b_K"][h]
    print("HEAD",h,"numeric query -> numeric key scores\n",q@kn.T/np.sqrt(6))
    print("numeric query -> BOS score",q@kb/np.sqrt(6))
    print("Q bias",W[pref+"b_Q"][h],"K bias",W[pref+"b_K"][h])
    print("numeric OV variation / BOS OV difference / position OV variation",
          np.linalg.norm((E[:11]-E[:11].mean(0))@V@O),
          np.linalg.norm((E[11]+P[0]-E[:11].mean(0)-P[1:].mean(0))@V@O),
          np.linalg.norm((P[1:]-P[1:].mean(0))@V@O))
    print("numeric OV singular values",np.linalg.svd((E[:11]-E[:11].mean(0))@V@O,compute_uv=False))

for l in range(2):
    A=W[f"blocks.{l}.mlp.W_in"]
    B=W[f"blocks.{l}.mlp.W_out"]
    b=W[f"blocks.{l}.mlp.b_in"]
    print("\nMLP",l,"bias range",b.min(),b.max())
    # Linear read/write paths only: no activations.
    print("token read singular values",np.linalg.svd((E[:11]-E[:11].mean(0))@A,compute_uv=False))
    print("position read singular values",np.linalg.svd((P-P.mean(0))@A,compute_uv=False))
    print("output->unembed singular values",np.linalg.svd(B@U,compute_uv=False)[:12])
    for h in range(4):
        ov=W[f"blocks.0.attn.W_V"][h]@W[f"blocks.0.attn.W_O"][h]
        print("head",h,"OV->MLP norm",np.linalg.norm(ov@A),
              "numeric OV->MLP variation",np.linalg.norm((E[:11]-E[:11].mean(0))@ov@A),
              "BOS diff OV->MLP norm",np.linalg.norm((E[11]+P[0]-E[:11].mean(0)-P[1:].mean(0))@ov@A))
    score=np.linalg.norm(B@U,axis=1)
    inds=np.argsort(score)[-12:][::-1]
    for j in inds:
        tr=E[:11]@A[:,j]
        print("neuron",j,"b",round(float(b[j]),3),"token reads",np.round(tr,2),
              "write highest classes",np.argsort(B[j]@U)[-4:],
              "write lowest classes",np.argsort(B[j]@U)[:4])
print("MLP0 output->MLP1 norm",np.linalg.norm(W["blocks.0.mlp.W_out"]@W["blocks.1.mlp.W_in"]))
